## ✅ What you need to know

You should be comfortable with the basics of R or Python:

- Writing simple functions
- Working with variables
- Using packages/libraries (installing and importing)

## 💬 During the sessions

As the RAP Accelerator is run in a _flipped classroom_ style, the sessions are highly engaging — don't expect to just sit back and watch! To get the most out of the programme, here's what we ask of you:

- **Complete the pre-work**: 60–90 minutes before each session. Essential, not optional.
- **Camera on**: we'll work in small groups, and we learn best when we can see each other.
- **Engage actively**: ask questions, work through examples, share what you're learning.
- **Bring a real project**: the [capstone project](../learning_materials/5_capstone/index.qmd) applies what you've learnt to something that matters to you.

## 🧑‍🏫 Need a quick refresher?

If you want to take part in the RAP accelerator but don't yet meet the prerequisites, there is a chance for you to upskill before October.

The NHS Open Analytics community is running an Introduction to R and RStudio course in September. Attending this will ensure you meet the prerequisites. You can [sign up online](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=slTDN7CF9UeyIge0jXdO49xonCqYusFJh3y-kXmKM_1UM0pRTVZLVVJDSzVVWjFXRTI1VTFXVFVVSS4u). On the sign-up form, please write that you heard about the workshop through SCIC. 

## Additional R and Python learning resources

If you wish to upskill with R and Python outside of this course, here are some suggested learning resources.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### R

- [Big Book of R](https://www.bigbookofr.com/010-start_here)
- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)
- [Software Carpentry: Programming with R](https://swcarpentry.github.io/r-novice-inflammation/)

- [teachR](https://teachingr.com/)
- [Geeks for Geeks R Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/r-language/r-tutorial/)

### Python

- [Coding for Economists](https://aeturrell.github.io/coding-for-economists/code-basics.html)

- [Kaggle Python](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/python)
- [W3 Schools Python Tutorial](https://www.w3schools.com/python/)
- [NHSPycom Coding Club](https://github.com/nhs-pycom/coding-club)

:::
